title: Cargo
description: Runs cargo commands from a workspace root, one process per command for every selected package, each task decided by its own package's diagnostics

cwd.description: Cargo workspace root, relative to the Nx workspace root

package.description: Package the task selects, passed to cargo as a package ID spec

warnings.description: Cargo `build.warnings` for the run; `deny` fails a task on any lint warning of its package

commands.description: Cargo invocations in order, a task stopping at its first failure

trailing.description: Arguments after --, passed on to the compiler run

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to every command
